message.reasoning:
Strong report. Check calculations quickly: sun-sync inclination at 600 km ~97.79° correct. Launch azimuth: sinβ = cos i / cos φ = cos97.79/cos5.2 = -0.1355/0.9959 = -0.136, β=-7.8°, correct. Period 5801 s correct. Ground track spacing: 2π·6378·5801/86164 ≈ 2698 km correct. Decay: Δa = 2π·(Cd A/m)·ρ·a² = 2π·(2.2·0.3/50)·1e-13·(6.978e6)² ≈ 2π·0.0132·1e-13·4.87e13 ≈ 0.40 m, correct. Sail: ×14.3 → 5.8 m, correct. Data budget: 60,000 km² × 40,000 px/km² (5m GSD → 40,000 px per km²) ×4×12 = 1.152e14 bits = 115 Gbit, correct. Access table plausible. Minor issues: eclipse 34 min claim, "Mount Pleasant" is actually in Tasmania? Mount Pleasant Radio Observatory is in Tasmania near Hobart — yes correct. Minor: no link budget, acknowledged. Minor: Vega C first flight 2021 vs 2025 launch fine. Minor: "latitude lower than 180° minus inclination" odd phrasing but fine. Minor: eclipse duration at 600 km with 97.8° inclination ~35 min, fine.

C1: Accomplished, 9. C2: Accomplished, 9 (minor: no link budget, no coverage analysis of station mask beyond elevation 0). C3: Accomplished, 8. C4: Accomplished, 9.
